description: mailbox.rs:254 compares mailbox role via r.to_string() \!= role_str, where role_str is the raw filter value from the client. This is correct only if MailboxRole::Display produces the exact camelCase wire format. If jmap_mail_types ever adds or changes a role's Display impl (e.g. for debug formatting), the in-process filter silently breaks. The comparison should go through serde instead: serialize the role to a JSON string and compare, or add a dedicated as_str() method that is explicitly the wire format.
title: MailboxRole::to_string() used for filter comparison: Display-format coupling risk
